title: Monster: Ruhenheim
alt: In heavy rain a man in a long coat stands with his back to the viewer and aims a pistol down an empty street. Far along the street a fair-haired man in a dark suit stands and holds a finger to his forehead. Old houses line the street, and a church tower stands at its end under dark clouds.
summary: A painting of a scene from Monster in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is the town of Ruhenheim, near the end of Monster, a manga by Naoki Urasawa. It rains, and the street is empty. Johan Liebert stands in the road and points to his forehead.
Doctor Kenzo Tenma aims a pistol at him. Tenma once saved the life of this man. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
